deltas.rationale: The period guard now validates edits to effective-date windows; production snapshot stays unchanged until migration deployment.
Canonical teaching occurrence now permits precisely one of a dated timetable slot or an unscheduled lesson plan and records an explicit completion review; production is unchanged until deployment.
The explicit one-source check rejects occurrences that claim neither or both a scheduled slot and unscheduled plan; existing scheduled identities remain intact.
An unscheduled plan gets one canonical occurrence through a partial unique index; scheduled slot/date uniqueness is retained.
